state:
Milestone `dossier`, goal `the-description-is-owed`, stage 2. `data/proofs/policy.json` now carries
`owes.all.about: true`, so `bun nv proofs --gate` counts a missing or misshapen `about.md`. It names
104 of 1159 features: 17 `Core\Time\DateTime` members, 1 language section and 46 tool sections with
no description, 27 descriptions over 200 words, and 13 features that owe more than a description.
Sixteen descriptions were written: `Core\Str::length`, `Core\RateLimit\Decision` (4),
`Core\Reflect\AttributeInfo` (5) and `Core\Time\Date` (6).

**The chain order cannot reach this goal as it stands.** Its check is the whole roster, and the 13
features are the 5 of `tools:install` and 8 of `tools:server`, which owe a test, an example and an
attack as well. Goals `tools-install` and `tools-server` own those and sit behind this goal on the
chain, and only the driver moves `live`. Nothing is blocked until every other description is written.
The closed goals' group checks (`bun nv proofs --verify --group <G>`) are red for every group in
the list above until its descriptions land; that is this goal's work and not a regression.

**One call made for the user, to look at.** Gap `nvs-ir/throws-on-an-array-key-that` named goal
`coalesce-assign` as its owner, and `bun nv owners --check` refuses every goal-owned gap, so
`bun nv verify` stopped at its `owners` step in every session. The record is back at
`milestone: M10`, and `docs/agent/goals/coalesce-assign.md` still has that goal delete it. If the
owner gate is meant to hold that goal open, `tools/nv/cmd/owners.ts:79` is what has to accept it.

The pack does not print `docs/examples/README.md` § *The description*; it is one `bun nv peek`.

46 tool sections with no description, each written from its own reference section and its one example: `tools:cli` (13), `tools:config` (13), `tools:php-differences` (12), `tools:agents` (4), `tools:editor` (3) and `tools:server/what-reaches-a-running-server`.
